title: DataQualityError
description: An individual data quality error pattern detected within a column. Deliberately not linked to a Column node by edge: profiler-generated column names may not exactly match stored Column node names (e.g. LLM generation variations).

type.description: Vocabulary type annotation for the node (e.g. dg:DataQualityError)

column.description: Column name as reported by the profiler (not an edge reference to a Column node)

errorType.description: Classification of the detected data quality issue

totalAffectedRows.description: Number of rows affected by this error, counted across the entire table

row.description: 1-indexed row number where this example occurs

errorExamples.description: Up to 5 illustrative occurrences of this error, each with its value and 1-indexed row
